rows.question: Which valve does the flow ratio control loop 031 ultimately act on, and through which functions does the signal pass?
rows.answer:
I could not determine that from the supplied P&ID graph. A drafted answer was withheld because 2 of its claims were not supported by the graph evidence.

What the graph tools returned:
- find_entities: '031' matches 4 entities and does not identify a single one. Use an entity id, or add line/type context.
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-1 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction YC031.4, ProcessInstrumentationFunction)
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-2 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FFIC031., ProcessInstrumentationFunction)
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-3 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FI031.2, ProcessInstrumentationFunction)
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-4 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FI031.1, ProcessInstrumentationFunction)
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-1 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction YC031.4) -> ActuatingFunction-1 [signal_line]
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-2 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FFIC031.) -> ProcessInstrumentationFunction-1 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction YC031.4) [signal_line]
- ActuatingFunction-1 -> GlobeValve-1 [operated_valve_reference]
- ProcessInstrumentationFunction-3 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FI031.2) -> ProcessInstrumentationFunction-2 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FFIC031.) [signal_line]
- ProcessSignalGeneratingFunction-1 -> ProcessInstrumentationFunction-3 (ProcessInstrumentationFunction FI031.2) [measuring_line]

rows.question: Which instrument functions send signals into FFIC031.?
rows.answer: The instrument functions that send signals into FFIC031 are FI031.2 and FI031.1. [E2.3, E2.4]

rows.question: What does flow indication FI031.1 get its measurement from?
rows.answer: FI031.1 receives its measurement from ProcessSignalGeneratingFunction-2 via a measuring line, where the measurement taken by the signal generating function is the input to the flow indication [E2.3].

rows.question: What is the set point of the flow ratio controller FFIC031.?

rows.answer: The set point of the flow ratio controller FFIC031 is not present in the loaded P&ID. [R2]
